title: Child Stimulation Month at PHMR
body:
Imagine your first experience on a boat being a trip to the fantastic Port Honduras Marine Reserve (PHMR)?

Well, as part of Child Stimulation Week, TIDE and Wil Maheia sponsored two boats to take preschoolers and guardians totaling 21 people from Jada’s Day Care and Learning Center to PHMR for the day.

Travelers were taught about life at PHMR, before inflating arm bands, rings and splashing around at West Snake Caye!

Photo Credit: Edwin Cabrera, Valerie Cus.
